env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A plain chain whose block lambda holds ? is a ?-chain for the guard order
# of && and ||, and every return of the block, const if and const switch
# bodies included, yields the element result. The ejected module builds and
# prints the native output.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/lambda_block_try.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/lambda_block_try.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/lambda_block_try.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/lambda_block_try.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/lambdablocktry

go 1.27
